entries.name: Improved Life Tap
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by $s1%.

entries.name: Suppression
entries.descriptionTemplate: Improves your chance to hit by $m1% and reduces all threat you generate by $m3%.

entries.name: Improved Corruption
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by $/1000;S1 sec and increases the damage it deals by $m2%.

entries.name: Malediction
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases all periodic damage done by your Warlock spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Soul Harvesting
entries.descriptionTemplate: You gain Soul Harvest for $1242853d if a victim is killed while afflicted with your Drain Soul. Soul Harvest allows your Mana to regenerate at $m1% of normal speed while you are casting spells, and grants a $m2% increase to your Mana regeneration.

entries.name: Improved Drains
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases health drained or damage done by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by $m1%.

entries.name: Improved Bane of Agony
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Bane of Agony by $s1%.

entries.name: Fel Concentration
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives you a $s1% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling or casting your Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, or Wrack spells.

entries.name: Amplify Curse
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by $s1%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by $s2%.  Lasts $d.

entries.name: Pandemic
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by $m1%.

entries.name: Malevolence
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Nightfall
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life, and Wrack spells a $m1% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by $17941s1%.

entries.name: Curse of Exhaustion
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the target's movement speed by $s1% for $d.  Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

entries.name: Siphon Life
entries.descriptionTemplate: Transfers $s1 health from the target to the caster every $t1 sec.  Lasts $d.

entries.name: Soul Siphon
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by $s1% per each of your other Affliction effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of ${$m1*3}%.

entries.name: Shadow Mastery
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Wrack
entries.descriptionTemplate: Tears the target apart from within, dealing $s1 Shadow damage every $t sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by $s2%. Lasts $d.

entries.name: Improved Health Funnel
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by $m1%, reduces its health cost by $m2%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by $m3%. Allows Health Funnel to be used regardless of your demon's health.

entries.name: Improved Imp
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage of your Imp's Firebolt spell by $s2% and the effect of its Fire Shield spell by $s1%.

entries.name: Demonic Embrace
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your total Stamina by $s1%.

entries.name: Unholy Power
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by $s1%.

entries.name: Demonic Aegis
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin and Demon Armor spells by $m1%.

entries.name: Improved Voidwalker
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Fel Vitality
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by $s1%, and increases your maximum Mana by $s2%.

entries.name: Demonic Energies
entries.descriptionTemplate: You heal your pet for $s1% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains $m2% of the Mana you gain.

entries.name: Improved Sayaad
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the effect of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss spells by $s1%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' and Incubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by $s2%.

entries.name: Demonic Sacrifice
entries.descriptionTemplate:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts $18789d. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by $18789s1%.

Voidwalker: Restores $18792s1% of your total Mana every $18792t1 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by $18791s1%.

Felhunter: Restores $18790s1% of your total Health every $18790t1 sec.

entries.name: Master Summoner
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter Summoning spells by $/1000;s1 sec and the Mana cost by $s2%.

entries.name: Decimation
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Soul Fire spell by $m2%. When you cast Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below $m3% health, they deal $m4% increased damage, and for the next $440873d your Soul Fire spell has its cast time reduced by $m1% and costs no Soul Shards.

entries.name: Fel Domination
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by $/1000;S1 sec and its Mana cost reduced by $s2%.

entries.name: Demonic Brand
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Searing Pain generates $s1% less threat and brands the target for $1293696d. Your pet's next $m2 attacks against the target generate high threat and deal $<minDam> to $<maxDam> Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet.

entries.name: Improved Felhunter
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Felhunter's Tainted Blood, the healing of its Devour Magic, and the detection level of its Paranoia by $s1%, and reduces the cooldown of its Spell Lock by ${$m2/-1000} sec.

entries.name: Soul Link
entries.descriptionTemplate: When active, $18814s1% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict $25228s1% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

entries.name: Demonic Knowledge
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to $s1% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.

entries.name: Master Demonologist
entries.descriptionTemplate:
Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active.

Imp - Increases Fire damage done by $m1%.

Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by $m2%.

Succubus/Incubus - Increases Shadow damage done by $m3%.

Felhunter - Reduces Magic damage taken by $m4%.

entries.name: Demonic Pact
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.

entries.name: Destructive Reach
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the range of your damaging spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage taken by the target from your attacks by $m1% for $17794d.

entries.name: Bane
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by $/1000;S1 sec and your Soul Fire spell by $/1000;S2 sec.

entries.name: Molten Skin
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces all damage taken by $s1%.

entries.name: Cataclysm
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Aftermath
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by $m2% and your Conflagrate spell has a $m1% chance to Daze the target, reducing the target's movement speed by $18118m1% for $18118d.

entries.name: Ruin
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Shadowburn
entries.descriptionTemplate: Instantly blasts the target for $s2 Shadow damage.  If a non-trivial target dies within $d of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

entries.name: Intensity
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives you a $s1% chance to resist interruption caused by damage while casting or channeling any Destruction spell.

entries.name: Agonizing Flames
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by $m1% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by $m2%.

entries.name: Conflagrate
entries.descriptionTemplate: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing $s1 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

entries.name: Pyroclasm
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Soul Fire spell a $s1% chance to Stun the target for $18093d, and your Rain of Fire and Hellfire spells a $s1% chance over their duration to Stun targets they damage for $18093d.

entries.name: Bane of Havoc
entries.descriptionTemplate: Afflicts the target for $d, causing $s1% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

entries.name: Fire and Brimstone
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell by $m2%.

entries.name: Shadow and Flame
entries.descriptionTemplate: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by $m3% for $1293816d, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by $m4% for $426311d. In addition, Conflagrate has a $m2% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a $m2% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.

entries.name: Incinerate
entries.descriptionTemplate: Deals $s1 Fire damage to your target and an additional $m2% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.
